stories.title: Do NFL superteams actually win? Barnwell sized up historic big favorites -- and the 2026 Rams
stories.summary: The Rams are loaded this season, and basically everyone is picking them to win the Super Bowl. But preseason darlings of the past 35 years haven't always met expectations.

stories.title: Sources: Bears expect Burden to miss preseason
stories.summary: Bears receiver Luther Burden III is expected to miss the preseason with a groin injury, but the team believes he'll be ready for Week 1 vs. Carolina, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Mexico beats U.S. in U20 final after suspect red
stories.summary: Mexico won its second Concacaf U20 championship in a row after beating the United States 2-0 at Estadio Azteca in the final on Sunday in Mexico City.

stories.title: Commanders star Tunsil to have triceps surgery
stories.summary: Commanders star left tackle Laremy Tunsil will undergo surgery to repair a torn triceps and is expected to miss significant time.

stories.title: Sources: Patriots TE Henry gets 2-year extension
stories.summary: Patriots standout TE Hunter Henry, 31, has signed a two-year contract extension. The deal is worth up to $20 million with $14.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
